title: Zed agent profile frontmatter
description: YAML frontmatter of an agent profile file, compatible with the Claude Code subagent file format (sources/claude-code-sub-agents-2026-10-30.md:291). The Markdown body after the closing --- is the system prompt (sources/claude-code-sub-agents-2026-10-30.md:270). Top level open: Claude Code ignores a field it does not recognize without reporting an error (sources/claude-code-sub-agents-2026-10-30.md:295), so a file written for a newer Claude Code must still load; Zed logs unknown fields. Zed-only fields live under `zed`, which is closed. Locations: personal profiles in the Zed configuration directory, project profiles in .zed/agents/.

name.description: Claude Code field (sources/claude-code-sub-agents-2026-10-30.md:302). Unique identifier, at most 256 characters, no `:`, must not start with `-` (sources/claude-code-sub-agents-2026-10-30.md:339). Hooks receive it as `agent_type`.

description.description: Claude Code field (sources/claude-code-sub-agents-2026-10-30.md:303). When the main agent should delegate to this profile.

tools.description: Claude Code field (sources/claude-code-sub-agents-2026-10-30.md:304). Allowed tools, as a comma-separated string or a YAML list; inherits every tool if omitted. Holds Claude Code tool names; Zed uses `zed.tools` when present.

disallowedTools.description: Claude Code field (sources/claude-code-sub-agents-2026-10-30.md:305). Denied tools, same format as `tools`; applied before `tools` (sources/claude-code-sub-agents-2026-10-30.md:450).

model.description: Claude Code field (sources/claude-code-sub-agents-2026-10-30.md:306). `sonnet`, `opus`, `haiku`, `fable`, a full model id, or `inherit`. Zed uses `zed.model` when present; a Claude alias has no meaning on a Zed provider such as vLLM.

permissionMode.description: Claude Code field (sources/claude-code-sub-agents-2026-10-30.md:307). Accepted, not applied by Zed 0.1: Zed writes a warning naming the field when it loads the profile.

maxTurns.description: Claude Code field (sources/claude-code-sub-agents-2026-10-30.md:308). Accepted and ignored by Zed (decided): a turn ceiling cuts the model, which the repository doctrine forbids. Zed writes this in its log when it loads the profile.

autoCompactWindow.description: Claude Code field (sources/claude-code-sub-agents-2026-10-30.md:309). Lower auto-compact window, in tokens.

skills.description: Claude Code field (sources/claude-code-sub-agents-2026-10-30.md:310). Skills preloaded into the context at startup, up to the first 32 distinct names (sources/claude-code-sub-agents-2026-10-30.md:627). Does not restrict which skills can be invoked.

mcpServers.description: Claude Code field (sources/claude-code-sub-agents-2026-10-30.md:311). Each entry is a configured server name, or an inline definition keyed by server name. Accepted, not applied by Zed 0.1: Zed writes a warning naming the field when it loads the profile.

items.description: Server name, or an object mapping one server name to its MCP config (open: the MCP config format is defined by MCP settings, not here).

additionalProperties.description: MCP server config, not interpreted by this schema (open: defined by the MCP settings).

hooks.description: Claude Code field (sources/claude-code-sub-agents-2026-10-30.md:312). Hooks active only while this agent runs, in the format of the hook settings. Restricted to the Zed events of the hook contract. A `Stop` hook becomes `SubagentStop` when the agent runs as a subagent (sources/claude-code-sub-agents-2026-10-30.md:799). Refused in a project profile (.zed/agents/): Zed refuses to load the profile, with a message naming the file, as project settings cannot declare hooks. Allowed in a personal profile (Zed configuration directory).

memory.description: Claude Code field (sources/claude-code-sub-agents-2026-10-30.md:313). Persistent memory scope. Accepted, not applied by Zed 0.1: Zed writes a warning naming the field when it loads the profile.

background.description: Claude Code field (sources/claude-code-sub-agents-2026-10-30.md:314). Accepted, not applied by Zed 0.1: Zed writes a warning naming the field when it loads the profile.

omitClaudeMd.description: Claude Code field (sources/claude-code-sub-agents-2026-10-30.md:315). Start without the user, project and local CLAUDE.md files. In Zed: without the project rules files.

effort.description: Claude Code field (sources/claude-code-sub-agents-2026-10-30.md:316). Effort level; available levels depend on the model.

isolation.description: Claude Code field (sources/claude-code-sub-agents-2026-10-30.md:317). Run in a temporary git worktree. Accepted, not applied by Zed 0.1: Zed writes a warning naming the field when it loads the profile.

color.description: Claude Code field (sources/claude-code-sub-agents-2026-10-30.md:318). Display color. Accepted, not applied by Zed 0.1: Zed writes a warning naming the field when it loads the profile.

initialPrompt.description: Claude Code field (sources/claude-code-sub-agents-2026-10-30.md:319). First user turn when the agent runs as the main agent. Accepted, not applied by Zed 0.1: Zed writes a warning naming the field when it loads the profile.

experimental.description: Claude Code field (sources/claude-code-sub-agents-2026-10-30.md:320). Map of experimental options; only `cacheTtl` is documented (sources/claude-code-sub-agents-2026-10-30.md:322). Open: Claude Code ignores other keys. Accepted, not applied by Zed 0.1: Zed writes a warning naming the field when it loads the profile.

zed.description: Zed extension. Fields that have no Claude Code counterpart, or whose Claude Code value cannot apply to Zed. Closed.

tools.description: Zed extension. Allowed tools by Zed name (`read_file`, `grep`, `terminal`…). Replaces `tools` in Zed; enforced by the tool filter in enabled_tools, so a refused tool is not even shown to the model. Subagent allowlist, on the model of Claude Code `Agent(worker, researcher)` (sources/claude-code-sub-agents-2026-10-30.md:513, sources/claude-code-sub-agents-2026-10-30.md:517): `spawn_agent(explorer, planner)` allows only those profiles; `spawn_agent` without parentheses allows every profile (sources/claude-code-sub-agents-2026-10-30.md:519); no `spawn_agent` entry means no subagent (sources/claude-code-sub-agents-2026-10-30.md:525). This list is the only source of truth for which profiles the agent may spawn.

items.description: A Zed tool name, optionally followed by a parenthesised, comma-separated list of profile names (only meaningful for spawn_agent).

disallowed_tools.description: Zed extension. Denied tools by Zed name. Applied before `zed.tools`, as in Claude Code.

model.description: Zed extension. Model of the agent, as a Zed provider and model id.

id.description: Model id as configured in Zed.

max_spawn_depth.description: Zed extension. Deepest subagent level this agent may create (0: it may not spawn subagents). Enforced at create_subagent: a refused spawn returns a reason to the model, which goes on.
